precision_escalation: Only when a decisive interval overlaps a safety boundary; retain every attempt.
initial_values: Exact archived binary64 values, preserved as float.hex and integer ratios.
independent_checker: Python Fraction arithmetic and bounded alternating Taylor sine; no producer or MPFR imports.
comparison_domain: All preceding published boxes must lie inside [-1,1] x [-3,3].
certificate_rule: u=-2 must cross an upper boundary; u=+2 must cross a lower boundary, with strict whole-interval separation.
simulator_diagnostics: Five archived PD-action replays and ten constant-extremum 200-step trajectories, each extremal trajectory independently replayed; float32 executed torques and raw-state safety.
simulator_seed: Reuse each source state's saved reset_seed; no new random sampling.
generation_repeat: Recompute each precision attempt once and require identical exact interval records.
